description: List the changes to the English text since the 1955 first printing: the words before and after, the year, the 1955 page, and the reason. Filter by `paper`, `ref`, `kind`, `edition` (the changes adopted in that one edition), or `from` and `to` (each change between two editions: `from: "1955", to: "srt-2015"` compares the first printing with srt-2015). With no filter, all of them (about 180). `applied` is false for a change that the Foundation lists but the default text does not have yet; `meta.applied` counts those that it has.

edition.description: Only the changes adopted in this edition, such as "srt-2021". "1955" has none.

from.description: With `to`: the changes adopted after this edition. Default "1955". Not with `edition`.

kind.description: text: words or punctuation. format: italics only. printing: a fault of the 1955 printing.

paper.description: Only the changes of this paper, "0" to "196".

ref.description: Only the changes of this paragraph, such as "98:3.8".

to.description: With `from`: the changes up to and including this edition. Default "srt-2024".

name: editions.variants
title: List the Changes Since 1955
